about: Every tunable number. One row = one value. Distances in Unreal centimetres, times in seconds.

worm scan rate while idle

the worm reels after you land on it
arrows per trick sequence

sequences to fill the bond bar
before you can leap again after being thrown

upward fling when thrown
untamed surfing speed
max untamed wander turn
how often the wild worm picks a new turn
tamed top speed holding W
tamed speed with no keys
speed while trick boost is active
speed change rate
tamed turn rate
how far the rider drops toward the sand while diving (the worm itself is never moved up or down)
rider height above the sand while surfacing
rider height above the sand while diving
rider distance behind the worm's position point
turn the worm mesh if its forward axis is not X
peak of a breach leap
breach leap duration
between breaches
dive tricks to fill the boost bar
boost duration
how far away your worm hears the call
worm speed when called
where a called worm stops
how close to remount your waiting worm
sand-surface trace reach above and below
width of the text bars
HUD text size
HUD vertical position (0 top, 1 bottom)
how far beside the worm you land when you dismount

how long the landing animation plays before the riding pose
1 = play the claw and sandbike rider animations
1 = show the worm double automatically when you get on
wire thickness (1 = 1 m wide cylinder)
where on your body the wire starts, above your position point
1 = rise and dip with the double's body where you sit
how quickly you follow the double's body (higher = tighter)
wait after the double appears before choosing the bone to sit on
